visualCharacteristics: Grid of guideline tiles, each with an image, heading, short text and a call-to-action button.
contentPattern: One row per tile: optional image cell, then a cell with h3 heading, text paragraph and CTA paragraph (<strong> link = primary, <em> link = secondary).
usage: Featured guideline/knowledge areas on hub pages (e.g. IF-Wissen, Redaktions-Guidelines).
reuseGuidance: Use for image-led teaser tiles. For text-only bordered cards use hub-cards.
